title: Vectors and Matrices
description: Arrows that add, and the grids of numbers that stretch and turn them. Most of physics, and every computer picture, is linear algebra.

puzzle.goal: A 2 x 2 matrix has trace T and determinant D. Write its larger eigenvalue λ.
puzzle.name: Characteristic root
puzzle.ask: Find λ for T = @{T} and D = @{D}.
puzzle.method: The eigenvalues solve λ² − Tλ + D = 0: they add to the trace and multiply to the determinant.
